title: The Swiggy address
premise: Daughter says she's at home cooking; Mummy, who is at home, says the Swiggy delivery guy just called her because the address is Mummy's.

script.text: Beta are you eating properly in Pune.
The delivery boy just called me. He is outside our house with your biryani.
i changed the address by mistake 😭
I have kept it. Rajma is in the fridge for you.

caption: biryani at the wrong door

post.caption: Mummy took the biryani and left you the rajma. Send this to a daughter who has done this.

cover.headline: I said rajma. Mummy got my *biryani
